status: candidate contract; seal and verdict belong to independent verifier

authority.context: fresh role; task/preflight and permitted baseline inputs only; no candidate patch
authority.regime: executado sem atestacao de isolamento tecnico
authority.role: L0 and observable-contract author, not implementation, oracle or verdict authority

measurement.status_and_diff: full exact before/after states embedded in measurement

measurement_before_decision.finding: Five valid ordinary std.typ routes (direct, alias, lexical shadow, full reexport, nested) say global in baseline and std in vanilla. Other named modules and real global retain correct names. Paired positive repr, lookup and calls agree.
measurement_before_decision.inferential_limit: Stored name appears sufficient for this named-module fragment. A legitimate named module with insufficient stored identity, need for another owner/public API, or different fresh observable refutes the narrow correction. Runtime observation alone does not establish upstream historical intent.
measurement_before_decision.order_comparison: No normal/reverse difference in 152 matched product/profile/case envelopes.
measurement_before_decision.instrumentation: Prior --color invocation failure fully retained in measurement. Removing unsupported option was instrumentation revision 1; prior runs never count as RED. No oracle or product implementation was consulted.

named_module_error.identity: Exact stored public name of the named module, independent of lexical spelling, alias, scope contents, nesting, import mode or profile.
named_module_error.ordinary_std_file: std, including direct import, alias, lexical shadow, nesting and full std wildcard reexport
named_module_error.other_names: ordinary global.typ -> global; map.typ -> map; arbitrary file -> its own name; calc -> calc; sym -> sym; color.map -> map
named_module_error.span: Resolved half-open source range covers exactly all bytes of the field identifier, excludes target, dot and neighbours. Source file identity and presentation path must be preserved separately.

obligations.positive_lookup: Successful import and field access preserve semantic value, kind, callable behavior and repr. Pair missing-field routes with working lookup/call to exclude invalid fixtures or import failures.
obligations.scope: Only missing-field identity in named Module diagnostics changes. Public Rust API, defaults, compatibility and eval/layout phase remain unchanged.

required_corpus: Ordinary std.typ, global.typ, map.typ and a non-reserved name with missing and present fields
Aliases, lexical std shadow, nested field access and full std wildcard reexport, all with paired valid positive lookup/call
Real global plus aliases, calc, sym and color.map with missing and present fields
At least nope and another identifier, with distinct line and column offsets
PDF data-cell/header-cell/table-summary without and with a11y-extras; exact negative hints/order/span and positive availability/kind/repr
pdf.attach and pdf.artifact present, with preserved call morphology; html feature boundary
Dictionary missing field preserves baseline whole-expression anchor; float NaN is-nan field access preserves field-only anchor
P1305 import/repr controls including bare imports, dynamic import boundary and aliases without modifying the protected historical regression suite

preservation.owners: Only field_access.rs productive body and tests.rs test additions are eligible. Other production owners, lab, nuclei, CLI and historical evidence are immutable.
preservation.nominal_special_cases: pdf/sym recognition, warnings, feature gates, dict and float diagnostics remain untouched.
debts: Dictionary baseline whole-expression span differs from vanilla field-only; preserve baseline exact envelope rather than claim parity.
Bare identifier imports may have vanilla this import has no effect warning absent in baseline. Freeze each affected fixture/profile envelope before seal; never globally strip warnings.

If an imported-file diagnostic has a preexisting presentation-path or import-trace difference, independently measure and freeze that exact case/profile envelope before seal. Resolve the true field anchor; change only contracted module name. Unmeasured path normalization or broad diagnostic suppression is forbidden.

mutation_families.negative: Keep old nominal std to global conversion

mutation_families.required_witness: ordinary non-global or calc/sym/map missing field
real global and/or alias missing field

mutation_families.negative: Use lexical alias name as module identity
mutation_families.required_witness: alias spelling differs from module stored name

mutation_families.negative: Correct only nope or another single field
mutation_families.required_witness: different missing identifier on ordinary std module
same ordinary route in an uncorrected profile

mutation_families.negative: Regress span to target or whole expression
Add or lose a diagnostic, hint, severity or error event
Delete or alter an existing successful module lookup

discrimination.execution: Real applicable mutants in disposable copy. Anchor by owner/function, preserve exact patch and observables, verify restoration. Invalid application or compilation is instrumentation failure, not killed mutant.
discrimination.positive: Preserved only when all contracted observables match
discrimination.opacity: Unknown only for genuinely incomplete public information; no invented opaque product fixture. No mandatory Unknown may seal or pass.

unknown_policy.forbidden: Never coerce Unknown into Preserved, silently drop diagnostics, or accept invalid positive import as RED.

gates.causality: L0 and independent baseline precede tests/candidate; V15/V26 before metadata reseal. Manifest freezes complete authors' outputs and baseline; verifier seals; candidate follows seal.
gates.red: Independent pre-candidate tests fail on the contracted ordinary-module name divergence; controls and fixture validity pass.
gates.green: The same tests and controls pass without oracle edits.
gates.interpretation: Filters must execute cases. Strict lint zero violations; dry-run no repairs. General-lint debt separately reported. Check new untracked artifacts too. Final focal bilateral matrix and real-mutant witnesses required; no general parity claim.

budget.stop: Two revisions with same failure vector/cause or missing public observability reopen design; no weakening.

freeze: Manifest pins final raw L0, semantic L0 and deterministic metadata provenance without cycle. Contract author owns semantic revisions; lineage metadata only may be deterministically resealed before seal. Protected-input changes after seal invalidate it. All receipts cite final manifest or causal preflight.
